timing_scope: Direct calls; excludes HTTP and has no time-bank enforcement
uncertainty_scope: Synthetic profiles; shared-card clustered CI, local block bootstrap conditional on observed seed trajectories, and whole-seed Student-t CI for persistent adaptation. Few seeds limit precision. No claim against unknown tournament submissions.

clustered_improvement.unit: bb per duplicate deal, profiles averaged within seed/deal
clustered_improvement.block_bootstrap_scope: Conditional on the observed seed trajectories; dependencies longer than the block are not captured

clustered_improvement_external.unit: bb per duplicate deal, profiles averaged within seed/deal
clustered_improvement_external.block_bootstrap_scope: Conditional on the observed seed trajectories; dependencies longer than the block are not captured

candidate_clustered_raw.unit: bb per duplicate deal, profiles averaged within seed/deal
candidate_clustered_raw.block_bootstrap_scope: Conditional on the observed seed trajectories; dependencies longer than the block are not captured

probe_scope: Independent higher-sample observation-only opponent; untimed strength comparison, not proof of equilibrium play or deployment time-bank compliance.
